title: GET_AVB_INFO on a descriptor other than AVB_INTERFACE: answer NOT_IMPLEMENTED
body:
A GET_AVB_INFO command whose descriptor_type is not AVB_INTERFACE (for example CLOCK_DOMAIN) is answered NOT_SUPPORTED today.

Owner decision 2026-10-17: answer **NOT_IMPLEMENTED** instead. This restores the behaviour the end station had before the AECP engine moved to the processor.

Specification trace, from the local IEEE 1722.1-2021 and Milan v1.2 Consolidated (2023-11-30) texts:
- IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.4.40.1: the command's descriptor_type is AVB_INTERFACE, the only valid target. 7.4.40.3 names only NOT_AUTHENTICATED, so the standard does not fix the status for another descriptor type.
- IEEE 1722.1-2021 Table 7-141: NOT_IMPLEMENTED (1) means the entity does not support the command type; NOT_SUPPORTED (11) means the command is implemented but its target is not supported.
- IEEE 1722.1-2021 9.3.5.3.3: an unimplemented command gets a correctly sized NOT_IMPLEMENTED response.
- Milan v1.2 5.4.2.23: GET_AVB_INFO is implemented per [ATDECC 7.4.40]; nothing on a wrong descriptor.
- The response for AVB_INTERFACE is unchanged.

Done when:
- GET_AVB_INFO with any descriptor_type other than AVB_INTERFACE is answered NOT_IMPLEMENTED with the correctly sized response (9.3.5.3.3);
- an AVB_INTERFACE target still answers SUCCESS, and an AVB_INTERFACE index that does not exist still answers NO_SUCH_DESCRIPTOR;
- suite cases cover each case with planted mutants;
- the compliance review records the decision with the clauses above;
- the processor suites and the parent consumer gates pass.
